title: System Integration Track - Manufacturing↔ERP Integration
description: Lane 21: Closes integration gaps between manufacturing and ERP subsystems identified by 20-agent integration scrutiny (2026-04-13)
source: 20-agent integration scrutiny: 82 dispatchers, 4,296 actions, 1,559 engines analyzed

milestones.title: EventBus ERP Event Categories

units.title: Add Invoice Events
units.description: invoice.created, invoice.sent, invoice.paid, invoice.overdue, invoice.voided

units.title: Add GL Events
units.description: gl.posted, gl.period_closed, gl.reconciled, gl.adjustment

units.title: Add Accounting Events
units.description: accounting.revenue_recognized, accounting.cost_accrued, accounting.margin_calculated

units.title: Add Shipping Events
units.description: shipping.dispatched, shipping.in_transit, shipping.delivered, shipping.returned

milestones.exit_gate: All 4 event categories in EventBus | Type-safe event payloads | Tests for each event type

milestones.title: Manufacturing→ERP Auto-Trigger Chain

units.title: Job→Invoice Hook
units.description: HookExecutor phase 'post-job-complete' emits invoice.created via InvoicingEngine

units.title: Quality→Ship Hook
units.description: quality.gate.passed + shipping_authorized → shipping.dispatched

units.title: Ship→GL Hook
units.description: shipping.delivered → gl.revenue_recognized (configurable recognition rules)

units.title: Cost Rollup Hook
units.description: job.completed → actual cost aggregation → margin calculation → gl.cost_accrued

units.title: Reactive Chain Wiring
units.description: Register 4 new EventBus reactive chains for the above flows

milestones.exit_gate: job.completed → invoice.created in <5s | All 4 chains testable | Manual override available

milestones.title: PersistenceBridge WAL (Crash-Safe Queue)

units.title: WAL File Format
units.description: Append-only log with sequence numbers, operation type, payload hash

units.title: Write Protocol
units.description: WAL append → PostgreSQL write → WAL checkpoint → acknowledge

units.title: Recovery Protocol
units.description: On startup, replay uncommitted WAL entries, dedupe by sequence

units.title: WAL Compaction
units.description: Background compaction of checkpointed entries, configurable retention

milestones.exit_gate: Zero data loss on simulated crash | Recovery time <10s for 1000 entries | WAL overhead <5%

milestones.title: CycleTime→Scheduling Auto-Bridge

units.title: CycleTime Event Emission
units.description: CycleTimeEstimator emits estimate.calculated with job_id, machine_id, duration

units.title: Capacity Consumer Hook
units.description: CapacityPlanningEngine subscribes to estimate.calculated, updates load forecast

units.title: Scheduling Consumer Hook
units.description: SchedulingEngine subscribes to capacity.updated, re-optimizes queue

units.title: Feedback Loop
units.description: actual.duration (from job.completed) → CycleTimeEstimator calibration factor

milestones.exit_gate: New quote → auto capacity update in <2s | Scheduling reflects estimates | Calibration improves ±10%/month

milestones.title: Chatter→Registry Dynamics Wiring

units.title: FRF Data Schema
units.description: Add frf_data field to MachineRegistry entries (frequency, compliance, damping)

units.title: Registry Lookup
units.description: ChatterStabilityLobeEngine queries MachineRegistry.getFRF(machine_id) at init

units.title: Fallback Defaults
units.description: If no FRF data, use conservative defaults by machine class (VMC, lathe, 5-axis)

milestones.exit_gate: ChatterStabilityLobe uses registry FRF for JM Die machines | Fallback for unknown machines

milestones.title: Frontend Dispatcher Coverage

units.title: Dispatcher UI Audit
units.description: Catalog all 82 dispatchers, map to existing pages, identify gaps

units.title: Priority Triage
units.description: Rank orphaned dispatchers by user value (autonomous, memory, tenant = high)

units.title: Autonomous Task Dashboard
units.description: UI for prism_autonomous: task list, status, start/stop/retry

units.title: Memory Graph Visualizer
units.description: UI for prism_memory: knowledge graph explorer, search, relationships

units.title: Multi-Tenant Admin
units.description: UI for prism_tenant: tenant CRUD, user assignment, usage metrics

units.title: Remaining Pages
units.description: NL Hook Editor, Predictive Failure Dashboard, Scientific Math Visualizer

milestones.exit_gate: ≤10 dispatchers without UI | High-value dispatchers covered | Route health check passes

milestones.title: Offline/Optimistic Frontend Updates

units.title: Offline Queue
units.description: IndexedDB-backed queue for mutations during offline, FIFO replay on reconnect

units.title: Optimistic Updates
units.description: UI updates immediately on user action, reverts on server rejection

units.title: Conflict Resolution
units.description: Last-write-wins with user notification for conflicts, manual merge option

units.title: Sync Status Indicator
units.description: Persistent UI indicator showing online/offline/syncing/conflict states

milestones.exit_gate: 5-minute offline session syncs cleanly | Optimistic updates feel instant | Conflicts surfaced to user
